diagnostics: implement DebugdAdapter Implement DebugdAdapter classes to adapt debugd daemon proxy interface. The general ideas of this extra layer are next: 1) Adapt proxy interface to have one callback instead of two: OnSuccess, OnError 2) Adapt proxy interface to cut wide functionality. 2.1) debugd can run commands from root. 2.2) each telemetry item must pass privacy review. So if we put all logic inside adapter it will be much simpler to check what telemetry we use or what commands do we run. 3) Move proxy details somewhere from core.cc file. Core class is growing and probably does not want to know such low-level details of proxy. BUG=b:139853065 TEST=unittests Change-Id: I6877c5c67af4b0468a3796c3ea16294a34dc7ec5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1766068 Tested-by: Oleh Lamzin <lamzin@google.com> Commit-Ready: Oleh Lamzin <lamzin@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Paul Moy <pmoy@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nick Crews <ncrews@chromium.org>
